name: Context Bot Development
install:
# Install dependencies and setup database
direnv allow
just setup
start:
# No background services needed for development
# Use 'just dev' to start the Phoenix server when ready
setupExplanation: This environment installs Elixir, Erlang, SQLite, and all development tools via Devbox. The `just setup` command installs Hex, Rebar, Mix dependencies, and prepares the SQLite database. No background services are started automatically - use `just dev` to start the Phoenix server when you're ready to test.
